hardware: AMD RYZEN AI MAX+ PRO 395 / Radeon 8060S (laptop; provisional pending the desktop gfx1151)
finding: Every numerics decision in this UD campaign was scored against an independent llama.cpp teacher. docs/EXECUTION-PROFILES.md section 6 defines the production gate as hipEngine strict versus candidate production on the same artifact, and section 7.1 states that an external engine is a comparison oracle, not the definition of hipEngine strict bytes. Re-scored against the correct reference the ranking inverts: the shipped four-quant integer-MMQ default breaches the binding absolute maximum-row ceiling, and W4A16 passes every threshold.
reference: The pre-MMQ capture with every IQ tensor on the strict dense GEMV, same production config, same 18 prompts x 9 forced tokens. This isolates the IQ routing change and subtracts the hipEngine-versus-llama.cpp codec gap common to every arm. It is the previous production default rather than a full strict profile: Q4/Q5/Q6 sit on T16 WMMA prefill in both reference and candidates, so they cancel for attribution but are not themselves strict.

calibrated_envelope.note: Rows above 2e-2 require explicit diagnosis even when the 5e-2 ceiling passes; they are never admitted automatically.

two_quant_mmq.verdict: FAIL on mean (1.038e-3 against 1e-3); max 0.0497 is just inside the ceiling

four_quant_mmq_shipped_default.verdict: FAIL - maximum row KL is 3.4x the absolute ceiling

worst_row_detail.reading: 570x apart at the integer route's worst position, so this is a real failure of that route there rather than measurement noise. Top-1 still agrees at that row, so it is a distribution failure rather than a token flip.

why_the_teacher_reference_misled.explanation: That gap is common to every arm and dominates the teacher-referenced numbers, which compresses differences between arms and, for the maximum, reorders them. Against the teacher the four-quant MMQ had the BEST max of all arms (0.0297) and W4A16 the worst (0.0409). Against strict those are 0.1704 and 0.0235. It also made every arm appear to 'fail' a 1e-3 mean limit that was never intended for that comparison - hipEngine strict itself sits at 0.001271 against the teacher.
why_the_teacher_reference_misled.campaign_pattern: Third cheap-proxy error of this campaign, all the same shape: bisecting IQ4_NL on divergence-from-default rather than teacher KL; validating W4A16 at the bf16 output floor; and scoring admission against an external oracle rather than strict.

consequence: By AGENTS.md - never land a production win that fails a binding threshold - the shipped four-quant integer-MMQ default should not stand as-is. W4A16 passes the envelope at a 12% throughput cost (150.9 against 171.9 tok/s). The policy was not changed in this unit: the human lead selected the current one explicitly, on the teacher-referenced numbers, and the decision is theirs with the corrected data.
limitations: The reference is the previous production default, not a full strict profile; a full strict run would be stricter still.
The earlier campaign decisions (per-tensor repack eligibility, dense T16 role coverage) were also taken on teacher-referenced numbers and have not been re-scored against strict.
Single host, laptop clocks; the accuracy ranking is same-host and deterministic, but absolute rates are provisional.
